page_title: BHA 3-1 NEW | Brighton v Newcastle 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Stuart Attwell is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Adam Lallana (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stuart Attwell ignores the protests.
90+7' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kaoru Mitoma.
90+5' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) was probably a bit loose with his words to Stuart Attwell, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+5' Brighton concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Newcastle will take a free kick near the side line.

90+2' 3 - 1 Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Bart Verbruggen is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:1.
90+2' A player from Brighton commits a rough challenge. Stuart Attwell blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Newcastle.
90+2' Flag up against Pervis Estupinan (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Here's the latest number of offsides – 2:0.
89' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Pascal Gross and he is replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
86' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book James Milner (Brighton) for his harsh tackle.
83' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) picked up a yellow card from referee.
81' Solly March goes off the pitch and Adam Lallana (Brighton) comes on.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Milner (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Evan Ferguson can be given a rest.
79' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
77' The game has come to an end for Billy Gilmour (Brighton). He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mahmoud Dahoud.
77' Substitution. Joao Pedro leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
76' The booking goes to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd).
74' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Matt Targett will be replaced by Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd).
74' Substitution. Alexander Isak will be replaced by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
70' 3 - 0 Evan Ferguson (Brighton) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Nick Pope. 3:0.
68' Matt Targett (Newcastle Utd) attempts to discuss the decision with Stuart Attwell, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

67' Ooh that was close! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.

65' 2 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Evan Ferguson (Brighton) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Nick Pope just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:0.
65' The current number of shots on goal is 4:0.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
58' Substitution. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) on for Sandro Tonali.
58' Substitution. Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) in, Miguel Almiron out.
58' Here is a change. Joelinton is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd).
58' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) jumps into a tackle and Stuart Attwell signals a foul.
56' Solly March (Brighton) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
55' Joao Pedro (Brighton) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
53' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brighton was in an offside position.
51' Solly March (Brighton) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
49' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
44' Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
43' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
41' The game is interrupted. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
41' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
40' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' Stuart Attwell couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pascal Gross (Brighton) and blew his whistle.
37' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Joelinton.
34' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call.
32' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
32' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' One of the players from Brighton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' CHANCE! Joao Pedro (Brighton) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Evan Ferguson (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
27' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Nick Pope sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
25' Solly March (Brighton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
23' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sees a yellow card from Stuart Attwell after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

22' Solly March (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul.
19' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

16' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
16' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

14' What a wasted opportunity by Evan Ferguson (Brighton)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Nick Pope makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
12' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
11' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

11' Solly March (Brighton) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Joao Pedro (Brighton) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
7' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Solly March (Brighton) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
4' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Stuart Attwell has a clear sight and sees a foul from Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd).
2' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brighton will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Stuart Attwell.
